task.title: Troubleshoot a Library operation
task.shortdesc: Recover safely from Library load, lifecycle, deletion, and action-status failures.

prereq.p: A Library load or row action reported an error, timed out, or left the visible rows in an unexpected state.

context.p: Troubleshooting starts by preserving context and reading the visible status before retrying.

step.cmd: Do not repeat a destructive action until the current status is clear.

info.note: Repeating archive or permanent delete after a partial failure can hide which action actually succeeded.

step.cmd: Record the profile name, row state, filter state, and visible status message.

info.p: Expected result: you can explain what BPM showed before retrying.
If the refreshed state matches the intended result, continue from the refreshed row list.

step.cmd: If the refreshed state is still wrong, reset search and filters and inspect the profile under all lifecycle states.

info.p: This distinguishes a hidden row from a failed or completed operation.

result.p: You know whether to retry the operation, restore the profile, stop before deletion, or continue from the refreshed Library view.

postreq.p: If the error repeats, stop the workflow and contact support with the visible message, profile name, schema channel, and current page.
